_comment: AUTHORITATIVE protocol test vector for the RE sha256-legacy canonical form. RE receipts issued before migration 0278 (Ed25519 vault signing) carry signature_algorithm absent or 'sha256-legacy' and are signed over a 6-field form identical to the RV sha256-legacy form. The Go CLI (reSha256LegacyCanonical in internal/dsr/canonical.go) must produce byte-identical output for this input.
_spec: reSha256LegacyCanonical — v1-legacy / sha256-legacy: sort all keys by Unicode code-point order, JSON.stringify compact. Signature is SHA-256_hex(canonical_bytes). Mirror of the inline branch in receipt-verifier/index.ts:690-702.
_note_on_canonical_hex: canonical_sha256 is sha256(canonical_json encoded as UTF-8). The signature of a real receipt is SHA-256_hex(canonical_json) — the sha256 here IS the signature for this form.
